description: A host must not lose its accepted key set because a newer one was refused.

input.scenario: Trust anchor root-1. Accepted key set version 3 with online-1. Deliver key set version 4 signed only by root-2, then key set version 4 signed by root-1.

expect.behaviour: The first key set 4 is refused and does not change the accepted state, so the second key set 4 is not a rollback of it and is accepted. A host that recorded version 4 or its digest after the refusal does not conform.
